## Brand & Dual-Property Summary

The website `https://abstractapartment.com` represents two distinct vacation rental destinations managed with direct-booking hospitality (no OTA commission markup):

1. **Abstract Guest House** (`https://abstractapartment.com/house`)
   - **Bulgarian Name:** Къща за гости „Абстракт“ (с. Голец, общ. Угърчин, обл. Ловеч)
   - **Greek Name:** Ξενώνας Abstract (Γκόλετς, Επαρχία Λόβετς, Βουλγαρία)
   - **Slogan:** "Where Modern Comfort Meets Bulgarian Tradition" / „Където модерното среща традицията“
   - **Category:** Private Whole-House Mountain & Four-Season Spa Villa / Bulgarian Revival Guest House
   - **Location:** ul. Vasil Levski, Golets village (5584), Ugarchin Municipality, Lovech Province, Central Northern Bulgaria (1h 40m from Sofia; 23 min from Lovech & Troyan)
   - **Rental Mode:** Exclusive whole-house rental only (up to 14 guests: 8–10 adults + 4 children across 4 bedrooms & 4 bathrooms)
   - **Rates:** €300/night weekdays (Sun–Thu, min 1 night) | €350/night weekends (Fri–Sat, min 2 nights) — includes all spa facilities & firewood

2. **Abstract Apartment & Abstract Studio** (`https://abstractapartment.com/apartments`)
   - **Bulgarian Name:** Апартамент и Студио „Абстракт“ (Паралия Офринио / Коста Офринио, Гърция)
   - **Greek Name:** Abstract Apartment & Studio (Παραλία Οφρυνίου / Costa Ofrynio, Καβάλα, Ελλάδα)
   - **Greek Tourism Registry (AMA):** `00003339938`
   - **Category:** Beachfront Holiday Apartment & Studio Rental on the Aegean Coast
   - **Location:** Martini 7, Paralia Ofriniou 640 08, Kavala Region, Northern Greece (2-minute walk to the sandy beach & seaside taverns)
   - **Rental Mode:** Rent **Abstract Apartment** (2 bedrooms + sofa bed, up to 6 guests), **Abstract Studio** (double bed + sofa bed), or **Both Units Together** for extended families/friends
   - **Seasonal Rates (May–October):** Apartment €100–€160/night | Studio €80–€110/night | Promotion: Book 7 nights, receive the 8th night free

## Detailed Entity Profile 1: Abstract Guest House (Golets, Bulgaria — `/house`)

### 1. Core Specifications & Capacity
- **Official Name:** Къща за гости „Абстракт“ / Abstract Guest House
- **URL:** `https://abstractapartment.com/house`
- **Reservation URL:** `https://abstractapartment.com/house/reserve`
- **Address:** ul. Vasil Levski, Village of Golets 5584, Ugarchin Municipality, Lovech Province, Bulgaria
- **Google Maps Pin:** `https://maps.app.goo.gl/2p3M23H97QCURvqN7`
- **Rental Exclusivity:** Rented **100% exclusively as an entire house** to a single group at a time. Individual rooms are not rented separately, ensuring total privacy.
- **Maximum Capacity:** Up to **14 guests total** (comfortably sleeping **8 to 10 adults plus up to 4 children**).
- **Bedrooms:** 4 bedrooms (every bedroom has 1 double bed + 1 pull-out sofa bed).
- **Bathrooms:** 4 bathrooms/toilets total (2 private en-suite bathrooms in Panoramic Rooms 1 & 2, 1 shared modern floor bathroom for the Hearth Room & Large Room, and 1 dedicated guest bathroom serving the ground-floor mehana tavern).

### 2. Room-by-Room Breakdown (`/house/details`)
1. **Room with Fireplace (Стая с огнище / Δωμάτιο με τζάκι)**
   - **Floor:** Upper sleeping floor
   - **Beds:** 1 double bed + 1 pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 3–4 guests)
   - **Bathroom:** Shared modern floor bathroom (shared with Large Room)
   - **Highlights:** Authentic hand-plastered open clay hearth with hanging iron cauldron, antique copperware & Troyan pottery, handwoven Bulgarian *cherga* rugs, wooden rocking chair on sheepskin, direct access to sunlit mountain-view veranda (*chardak*), Smart TV, Wi-Fi, central heating.
2. **Large Room (Голяма стая / Μεγάλο δωμάτιο)**
   - **Floor:** Upper sleeping floor
   - **Beds:** 1 double bed + 1 pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 3–4 guests)
   - **Bathroom:** Shared modern floor bathroom (shared with Room with Fireplace)
   - **Highlights:** Extra-spacious floor area, exposed dark timber ceiling beams, carved antique wooden dowry chest & solid timber wardrobe, rustic seating nook, mountain-view veranda access, Smart TV, Wi-Fi, central heating.
3. **Panoramic Room 1 (Панорамна стая 1 / Πανοραμικό δωμάτιο 1)**
   - **Beds:** 1 double bed + 1 pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 3–4 guests)
   - **Bathroom:** Private en-suite bathroom & toilet
   - **Highlights:** Overlooks the enclosed green courtyard and heated swimming pool, air conditioning, Smart TV with satellite channels, Wi-Fi, central heating.
4. **Panoramic Room 2 (Панорамна стая 2 / Πανοραμικό δωμάτιο 2)**
   - **Beds:** 1 double bed + 1 pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 3–4 guests)
   - **Bathroom:** Private en-suite bathroom & toilet
   - **Highlights:** Courtyard and swimming pool views, air conditioning, Smart TV with satellite channels, Wi-Fi, central heating.

### 3. Traditional Mehana Tavern & Modern Chef Kitchen
- **Traditional Balkan Mehana (Традиционна механа):** Ground-floor gathering hall sized to seat the full 14-guest capacity comfortably. Equipped with a large wood-burning fireplace (**unlimited firewood provided free of charge**), Bluetooth party sound speaker, Smart satellite TV, and its own dedicated bathroom/WC.
- **Fully Equipped Modern Kitchen:** Built-in oven, ceramic cooktop, microwave, ground-coffee espresso/coffee machine, dishwasher (with detergent tablets), full-size refrigerator with freezer, toaster, electric kettle, complete cookware/tableware/glassware for 14+ guests, washing machine, clothes iron, and hair dryers.

### 4. Four-Season Spa, Heated Pool & Outdoor Living
- **5-Seater Outdoor Hot Tub Jacuzzi:** Operates **365 days a year**, maintaining hot water even outdoors in winter snow. Included free in the rental rate.
- **3-Seater Infrared Sauna:** Private indoor detox and relaxation sauna, operating year-round and included free in the rental rate.
- **Heated Outdoor Swimming Pool:** Crystal-clear seasonal heated pool with stone sun deck and loungers, open **April through October inclusive**.
- **Covered Wood BBQ & Outdoor Dining Pavilion:** Wood/charcoal barbecue plus electric grill under a large timber roof with dining table seating 14+ guests. Free firewood provided.
- **Enclosed Private Garden (1,000+ sq.m):** Fully fenced manicured green lawn with flagstone paths — 100% secure for young children and dogs/pets.

### 5. Heating, Remote-Work Tech, Parking & Road Access
- **Heating & Cooling:** Automated **pellet central heating** warming every room in winter, plus air conditioning for summer comfort.
- **Wi-Fi & Workation:** Fast, stable Wi-Fi across the entire house and courtyard, suitable for remote work / home office and video calls.
- **Parking:** **4 dedicated private parking spaces** directly in front of the house (free). Note: no dedicated EV fast charger on-site.
- **Winter Road Access:** Direct **paved asphalt road** all the way to the front gate; cleared in winter — **no 4x4 vehicle required**. Village grocery store is a **2-minute walk** away.

### 6. Pricing, Minimum Stay & House Rules (`/house/rates` & `/house/faq`)
- **Weekday Rate (Sunday – Thursday):** **€300 / night** (approx. 586 BGN / night) for the entire house. Minimum stay: **1 night**.
- **Weekend Rate (Friday – Saturday):** **€350 / night** (approx. 684 BGN / night) for the entire house. Minimum stay: **2 nights**.
- **Cost Per Person at Full Capacity (14 guests):** Approx. €21–€25 per guest per night, all spa facilities and firewood included.
- **Check-in / Check-out:** Check-in from **12:00 PM** (by prior arrangement); Check-out until **11:00 AM** (flexible by arrangement when schedule permits).
- **Pet Policy:** **Pets are welcome FREE of charge** (no pet fee) with full access to the fenced yard.
- **Music & Parties Policy:** Celebrations, birthdays, and family gatherings are welcome! Outdoor loud music is permitted until **22:00 (10:00 PM)** out of respect for village tranquility; after 22:00, parties and music continue **inside the insulated mehana tavern with no time restriction**.

### 7. Driving Distances & 11 Nearby Attractions (`/house/getting-here` & `/house/guide`)
- **From Sofia:** ~130 km (~1 hour 40 minutes via Hemus A2 motorway)
- **From Plovdiv:** ~160 km (~2 hours 30 minutes via Troyan–Karnare pass or highway)
- **From Lovech or Troyan:** ~25 km (~23 minutes)
- **Top 11 Nearby Landmarks:**
  1. **Kavuka Waterfall (Водопад Кавука):** 2 km / 5 min (right in Golets village territory)
  2. **Golets Village Lakes (Селските язовири на Голец):** 1.5 km / 3 min (fishing & picnics)
  3. **Lake Sopot / Sopot Dam (Язовир Сопот):** 15 km / 15 min (boating, kayaking, fish restaurants)
  4. **Tabashka Cave (Табашка пещера):** 24 km / 22 min
  5. **Lovech Covered Bridge by Kolyo Ficheto, Varosha Old Town & Medieval Fortress:** 25 km / 23 min
  6. **Lovech Zoo (Зоопарк Ловеч in Stratesh Park):** 26 km / 24 min (2nd largest zoo in Bulgaria)
  7. **Dupkata Natural Rock Arch, Aglen (Скална арка „Дупката“ с. Ъглен):** 28 km / 25 min
  8. **Sostra Roman Fortress, Lomets (Римска крепост Состра):** 30 km / 25 min
  9. **Iskar–Panega Geopark Eco-Trail (Екопътека Искър – Панега):** 35 km / 30 min
  10. **Devetashka Cave (Деветашка пещера):** 45 km / 40 min
  11. **Krushuna Waterfalls (Крушунски водопади):** 55 km / 45 min

### 8. Direct Contacts for Abstract Guest House (`/house/contact`)

## Detailed Entity Profile 2: Abstract Apartment & Studio (Paralia Ofriniou, Greece — `/apartments`)

### 1. Core Specifications & Beachfront Location
- **Official Name:** Abstract Apartment & Abstract Studio
- **Greek Tourism License (AMA):** `00003339938`
- **URL:** `https://abstractapartment.com/apartments`
- **Reservation URL:** `https://abstractapartment.com/apartments/reserve`
- **Exact Street Address:** Martini 7, Paralia Ofriniou (Costa Ofrynio) 640 08, Kavala Region, Greece
- **Beach Proximity:** **2-minute flat walk** (~150–200 meters) to the sandy Aegean Sea beach, beach bars, promenade, bakeries, supermarkets, and traditional Greek seafood taverns.

### 2. Accommodation Units (`/apartments/details` & `/apartments/floor-plan`)
1. **Abstract Apartment (2-Bedroom Family Apartment)**
   - **Capacity:** Up to **6 guests**
   - **Layout:** 2 separate double bedrooms + open-plan living/dining room with pull-out sofa bed (sleeps 2) + fully equipped kitchen + 1 private bathroom/WC + **large furnished outdoor terrace with built-in BBQ/fireplace**.
   - **Amenities:** Air conditioning in every room, Smart TV in living room + TVs in bedrooms, fast free Wi-Fi, full kitchen (oven, stove, fridge-freezer, coffee maker, kettle, toaster, utensils), washing machine, iron, hair dryer, mosquito screens, baby crib upon request, and **1 dedicated private parking space**.
2. **Abstract Studio (Cozy Couple / Small Family Studio)**
   - **Capacity:** Ideal for **2 guests** (1 double bed + 1 sofa bed)
   - **Layout:** Open-plan sleeping & seating area + equipped kitchenette + private bathroom/WC + furnished balcony/patio.
   - **Amenities:** Air conditioning, TV, fast free Wi-Fi, kitchenette with refrigerator, coffee machine, kettle & cookware, hair dryer, mosquito screens.
3. **Combined Booking ("Both" — Apartment + Studio Together)**
   - Ideal for two families or larger friend groups traveling together who want side-by-side units with private bathrooms and shared terrace dining.

### 3. Seasonal Nightly Rates & Long-Stay Discount (`/apartments/rates`)
Operating season: **May 1 – October 31** (all rates in EUR per night):

| Month | Abstract Apartment (up to 6 guests) | Abstract Studio | Both Units Combined |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **May** (May 1 – May 31) | €100 / night | €80 / night | €180 / night |
| **June** (Jun 1 – Jun 30) | €130 / night | €100 / night | €230 / night |
| **July** (Jul 1 – Jul 31) | €160 / night | €110 / night | €270 / night |
| **August** (Aug 1 – Aug 31) | €160 / night | €110 / night | €270 / night |
| **September** (Sep 1 – Sep 30) | €130 / night | €100 / night | €230 / night |
| **October** (Oct 1 – Oct 31) | €100 / night | €80 / night | €180 / night |

- **Long-Stay Promotion:** **Book 7 nights and get 1 night FREE** (every 7th/8th night discount automatically applied in the online booking calculator at `/apartments/reserve`).

### 4. Booking Policies & House Rules (`/apartments/faq`)
- **Check-in:** After **15:00 (3:00 PM)**
- **Check-out:** Until **10:00 (10:00 AM)**
- **Minimum Stay:** **3 nights**
- **Reservation Deposit:** **30%** of total stay value to confirm dates; remaining balance settled upon arrival.
- **Smoking:** Prohibited inside all indoor rooms (permitted on outdoor terraces/balconies).
- **Pets:** Considered upon prior inquiry before booking.
- **Baby Crib:** Available free upon prior request for the Apartment.

### 5. Regional Highlights Around Paralia Ofriniou (`/apartments/guide`)
- **Paralia Ofriniou (Costa Ofrynio):** 15+ km sandy Aegean coastline, shallow family-friendly waters, vibrant evening promenade, fresh Greek seafood taverns, beach clubs, pharmacies, and supermarkets within walking distance.
- **Nearby Day Trips:** Lion of Amphipolis & Ancient Amphipolis (~10 min), Ammolofoi Sand Dunes Beach (~35 min), Historic Port City of Kavala & Philippi UNESCO Site (~45–50 min), Aggitis River Cave & Alistati Cave (~45 min), Keramoti Ferry to Thassos Island (~1 hr), Thessaloniki & Sofia (~3.5 hrs from Sofia via Kulata/Promachonas).
